The model does not reproduce the dataset answers; mean logit diff is slightly negative (-0.07 / -0.08) with std ~0.27, i.e. no margin for the labelled answer. local-full, full precision.

The model is at chance on the bench task: argmax accuracy 0.09 (E0002) and 0.1175 (E0003) against a chance level of 0.14 (7-token vocabulary) to 0.20 (5 symbols); logit diff correct-vs-incorrect averages -0.07 and -0.08, std 0.26-0.27. Example predictions are mostly 'ko' or 'fu' regardless of the expected answer. There is no behaviour to explain, so no circuit is claimed.
